div.l: He wated aftir no pompe / ne reuerence.
Ne maked him / a spised conscience
But cristis lore / and his appostolys twelve
He tawhte / but first he folwed it him selve
Wyth him ther was / a plowman was his brothir Plowman
That hadde lad of dong / wel many a rother
A trewe swynker / and a good was he
Lyvyng in pees / and in ꝑperfet charite
God loved he best / wᵗith all his hole herte
At all tymes / thowh he gamed or smert
And than his neighbore / ryght as him selve
He wolde troissh / and therto dyke and delve
For cristis sake / wᵗith eủery pore wyght
Wythouten. hyere / If it lay in his myht
His tithes paid he / ful faire and wel
Both of his propir swynk / and of his catel
In a tabard he rood / vpon a mere
Ther was also a Reve / and a Millere
A sompnore / and a pardoner also
A mancyple and my self / ther was no moo
THe Millere was / a stowt cherl for the nonys
Wel byg he was / of brawn and eke of bonys
That p̉reved wel / for over wher he cam
At wrastelyng he wolde / alwey haue the ram
He was short shuldred / brood and a thykke knarre
Ther was no dorre / that he ne wolde heve of barre
Or breke it at a rennyng / wyth his heed
His berd as any sowe / or fop was reed
And therto brood / as thowh it were a spade
Vpon the cop ryht / on his nose he hade
A werte / theron stood / a toft of herys
Rede as a brestyll / of a sowys erys
His nose ther / blak were and wyde
A swerd and a bokeler / bar he be his syde /
